profile.headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer @ Apple  &   Woman Chess Grandmaster

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant:
• Computer Science Department, Fall 2012 to 2013 (Python), Spring 2014 (C)
• Evaluated student performance by grading exams, quizzes and programming assignments.
• Taught recitations, labs, and helped students to become proficient at using Python and C.

positions.title: Summer Software Intern
positions.description:
Antenna Systems Team:
•	Wrote Python scripts to automate testing using Radio Frequency (RF) equipment.
•	Designed and implemented software refactoring with appropriate object oriented architectures.

positions.title: Woman Chess Grandmaster
positions.description:
Accomplishments:
• USA- Chess College of the Year (2007)
• Pan American Intercollegiate Team (2007 - 2011) 
• First Woman Chess Grandmaster from Colombia (2010) It is a lifetime title.

company.name: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description:
• Designed a Restricted-Boltzmann-Machine in Python to simulate a “Spiking Neuron Model” 
• The project was directed by a Neuroscience Professor and presented at the Brain Mind Institute.
